mainEntity.name: How is a whole-home renovation phased to minimize disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phasing might involve tackling one level at a time, completing critical systems first, or sequencing work so that at least part of the home remains usable, depending on scope and whether you plan to live on site.
